user.title: Bellweather
user.description: The weather here and now, measured, and the best forecast for your home, scored against what was measured. These two settings apply to every location; the first location comes next. Every choice is explained in the documentation on privacy, security and sources.

data_description.precision: What services that need a point receive. Exact: this location. Rounded: the centre of a grid cell of this size (the point can be up to 0.7 times the size away). Stations, airports and radar never need the point: they receive a larger area or nothing, and the nearest one is chosen inside Home Assistant, so for them rounding costs nothing. The forecast and the model values answer for the rounded point: 1-5 km keeps the advantage of the high-resolution regional models, 10 km (default) is a middle way, 25 km hides most and makes the forecast less local near hills and coasts.
data_description.sources: Each source you switch off receives nothing at all. Switching one off makes the values less direct or less local.

location.title: Location
location.description: Name the place and put the pin on it. The search is optional.

data_description.name: Becomes the device name and the start of the entity ids, for example weather.home.
data_description.search: Optional: a town, a postcode, or a street address such as "Main Street 5, Town". Only what you type is sent. A place name goes to Open-Meteo's place search, which Bellweather already uses for the forecast. Text with a house number or a comma, or a name Open-Meteo does not know, goes to the address search: OpenStreetMap's Nominatim, unless changed in Bellweather's options. A house is found only where OpenStreetMap has its number; otherwise you get the street and move the pin. Leave it empty to place the pin by hand.
data_description.location: Drag the pin or click on the map. Nothing is sent while you use the map. Distances to stations are always measured from the pin, inside Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: {name}
reconfigure.description: Settings for this location only. Open a page, change what you like, and its button brings you back to this menu. Nothing is saved until you choose Save and close; the X closes without saving.

menu_option_descriptions.sensors: Your own measurements at this location
menu_option_descriptions.members: Your weather entities in this location's blend
menu_option_descriptions.stations: Ignore a station; how far and how high a station may be
menu_option_descriptions.save: Applies all changes and reloads Bellweather

sensors.title: Your own sensors
sensors.description: Optional. Pick the sensors you have at {name} and leave the rest empty. Your own sensors win over every public source. Only sensors of the right kind are offered. "Back to the menu" keeps what you entered; nothing is saved until "Save and close".

data_description.local_rain_state: A rain detector (moisture class). Leak sensors share this class: pick the rain one.
data_description.local_pressure: Pressure reduced to sea level (often called relative pressure). Absolute pressure at the sensor is not converted.
data_description.weather_entity: Used only when no observation is available for a value.

members.title: Forecast members
members.description: Optional, for {name}. "Back to the menu" keeps what you entered; nothing is saved until "Save and close".

data.forecast_members: Your weather entities as forecast members

data_description.forecast_members: Optional. Their hourly forecasts join the blend, are recorded and scored like the built-in models, and are weighted by their own record after about 20 days. Nothing leaves Home Assistant for this.

stations.title: Stations and limits
stations.description: When nothing is within the limits: each value has a fixed order of sources. If no official station reports within its limits, the nearest airport within its limit is used; if there is none either, the weather model's value for this point. The entity's source attribute always says which one it is. Precipitation in the last hour has no model step: without radar or a station in range it shows as unavailable rather than a guess. Larger limits find a value more often, smaller ones keep it closer; the defaults are starting values. "Back to the menu" keeps what you entered; nothing is saved until "Save and close".

data_description.excluded_stations: A station that gives wrong values, for example one in a sheltered spot. The list shows the stations seen near the location.

archive.title: Airport archive

data.use_airport_archive: Learn from the nearest airport's archive at once

data_description.use_airport_archive: Off by default. On: the Iowa Environmental Mesonet sends 60 days of the nearest airport's reports, so the forecast is corrected from the first day instead of after about 20 days. Cost: one more service learns that airport's code, which says roughly where you live.

archive.description: "Back to the menu" keeps what you entered; nothing is saved until "Save and close".

search.title: Address search
search.description: Used only while you place a location, and only for text with a house number or a comma, or a name Open-Meteo's place search does not know. Only the typed text is sent, at most once a second, and the same text is not asked again for a day. The default is OpenStreetMap's Nominatim; its usage policy asks that applications can switch to another server or stop, which is what this setting does. "Back to the menu" keeps what you entered; nothing is saved until "Save and close".

data_description.address_server: https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org, or your own or another provider's Nominatim-compatible server (https only). Empty: no address search; place names still work, and the pin can always be placed by hand.

error.invalid_server: Give an https address of a Nominatim-compatible server, without a user name, password or query; or leave it empty.

options.rainviewer: Radar at the exact point and the radar nowcast (RainViewer)
options.open_meteo: Model values and snow depth (Open-Meteo, ECMWF)
options.ims: Satellite snow map, Northern Hemisphere (NOAA/USNIC IMS)
options.met_nowcast: Official radar nowcast, Nordic countries (MET Norway)

options.none: None of these: back to the map
